meta.methodology: Difference-in-differences on log daily volume; 90-day symmetric window
caveats: NEAR's own volume fell 19% across the switch; the positive ATT exists only because the controls fell further
Parallel trends fails: NEAR trended +195%/yr pre-period against -52%/yr for the controls, and trend-adjusting reverses the sign of the result
The bootstrap CI resamples daily rows and captures only noise in the means; dispersion across the 3 controls gives a much wider interval
4 units total; the permutation test cannot return a p-value below 0.25, so it cannot reject anything
Controls (1inch, Paraswap, Jupiter) are larger/more mature protocols; different growth dynamics from a young NEAR Intents
90-day window coincided with broader DeFi volume contraction; market cycle not isolated
DiD identifies relative performance vs controls, not absolute causal effect of the fee switch
The event tested a contract-level fee measured elsewhere at 0.01 bps, so it generalises poorly to a 5 bps enforced take

cross_control_ci_95.basis: dispersion across the control units, which the daily bootstrap does not capture

trend_adjusted.basis: raw ATT less the pre-period slope differential carried across the window gap

did_estimate.interpretation: NEAR volume changed by 1.11x (95% CI: 0.97-1.25x) relative to aggregator controls in the 90 days after the fee switch. CI includes 1.0; no statistically significant volume impact detected.

permutation_test.note: NEAR ATT ranks 3/4 among permutations (percentile=75%). NEAR is not an outlier; consistent with no treatment effect.

parallel_trends.assessment: Pre-period slopes differ materially; the DiD estimate conflates trend with treatment
parallel_trends.note: NEAR was trending up before the switch while the controls trended down. Carrying that differential across the window gap gives the trend_adjusted estimate above, which points the opposite way from the raw ATT. The raw estimate should not be read as evidence that demand tolerated the fee

full_history_context.note: Full pre/post split includes NEAR Intents early growth phase (Dec 2024 onward); inflates apparent post-switch growth
